description.p: Vaultime tracks how long you play your PC games, across launchers and standalone games. It keeps runtime, active playtime and idle time apart and stores every session in a tamper-evident log on your computer.

ul.li: Detects running games automatically and records sessions
Finds games from Steam, Xbox, Epic, GOG, EA and other launchers, and scans common game folders
Shows your library with artwork from your game folders
Local backups, plus optional encrypted backup to an invite-only server
